CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, April 19, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco-Chan, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Maria Jimenez, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE MARCH 15, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  March 15, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE
  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, March 15, 2023
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:00 P.M. on Wednesday, March 15, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco-Chan, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Jimenez.
Committee Members Absent: Commission Member Massaro
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard and
Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE JANUARY 18, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E.
MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the minutes from the January 18, 2023 regular meeting were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Vice President Saunders and Council Member Perez are discussing project locations and types of
art for District 4. Commission Member Hermano has been working on a budget and estimate for
her proposed mural project at the Alhambra Historical Museum. President Canseco-Chan and
Vice Mayor Maza are discussing locations for a sculpture and awaiting an estimate on materials
and installation. Commission Member Jimenez and Mayor Andrade-Stadler plan to meet and
identify 10 electrical boxes in District 5 and will return to the next meeting with a budget.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared details for the following upcoming events: Emergency
Preparedness Fair, Bunny Hop, Eco Fair, and Arbor Day. Recreation Supervisor Leonard invited
the Commission and their families to attend and participate.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Frank Bodeman introduced himself to the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and
expressed interest in joining the commission in the future.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and seconded by Commission Member Hermano, the
March 15, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:48 P.M.
